image.run.measure_html:
In Heartopia, open an empty drawing in the {format} format, maximum detail, pencil selected, zoom at minimum.
DodoTopia will fill the background, paint swatches and markers, measure the exact size of the cells on screen, test the stroke rhythm, then save the result. The test drawing is undone if the game’s Undo button is set up; otherwise, open a new drawing afterwards.
image.run.start_html:
To draw: {name} — {format} format, {w} × {h} cells, {painted} cells to paint.

In Heartopia, open a drawing in the {format} format, detail level at maximum, pencil tool selected, no zoom.

Drawing starts 3 s later: don’t touch the mouse or the keyboard. Any key stops it; to resume an interrupted drawing, start it again on the same canvas: only the missing cells are painted.

image.calib.prep_draw_html:
In Heartopia, before you start:

  1. 1Open a drawing in the {format} format
  2. 2Set the detail level to maximum
  3. 3Turn on the grid (grid button above the canvas)
  4. 4Keep the game window at the same size during the whole setup

These settings are only asked once. The positions are then saved, step by step.
